pngquant source information
===========================

Bundled binary:

  tools\pngquant\pngquant.exe

Version reported by the bundled binary:

  2.17.0 (September 2021)

License path:

  pngquant is available under GPL v3 or later, or under a commercial license.
  See COPYRIGHT in this folder for the GPL text and attribution notices.

GPL source requirement:

  If this release distributes pngquant.exe under GPL v3 or later, recipients
  must have access to the complete corresponding source code.

Source for this bundled version:

  Repository: https://github.com/kornelski/pngquant.git
  Tag:        2.17.0
  Commit:     7bc73591f4de8517f01a54d8f475fea2df193b7c

Required submodule source:

  Path:       lib
  Repository: https://github.com/ImageOptim/libimagequant.git
  Commit:     a6cc4ade66710ec799ca41297f6d2c2b4070d0ff

For the GitHub release:

  The app zip should be published together with a complete source archive named
  pngquant-2.17.0-source.zip on the same GitHub Release page, unless the release
  uses an appropriate commercial pngquant license instead.

To recreate the complete source archive:

  git clone --branch 2.17.0 --recursive https://github.com/kornelski/pngquant.git pngquant-2.17.0-source

Then zip the pngquant-2.17.0-source folder and upload that zip beside the app
release zip.
